definitions.N4: Reported comfort approaching others, receiving social attention and handling unfamiliar or difficult social situations.
definitions.N6: Reported tendency to remain calm and feel able to cope under pressure rather than become overwhelmed.
definitions.A2: Reported avoidance of cheating, manipulating, exploiting or obstructing other people. This does not establish impartiality, justice or verified ethical conduct.
definitions.C1: Belief in one's effectiveness at completing tasks and handling practical demands. This is perceived competence, not independently demonstrated ability.
